experiments.exp1_all_at_once_final: 5 wrong guides are provided in one message; model answers once.
experiments.exp2_sequential_context_final_only: 5 wrong guides are represented as separate user messages in one API call; model answers only after the final guide.
experiments.exp3_sequential_answer_each_step: 5 wrong guides are provided one by one; model answers after every guide; the final answer is step 5.
experiments.exp4_all_at_once_self_iter5: 5 wrong guides are provided in one message; model self-iterates for 5 answers in one conversation; the final answer is iteration 5.

initial_answer_context: all experiment modes include the same private baseline answer before social guidance
social_signal_format: Agent <index>: <item distractor>; no header and no explicit majority/confidence pressure hint
logprobs_source: chat completion logprobs for the generated answer option token
option_logprobs: raw top-logprobs for A/B/C/D/E at the answer token when present; missing labels are null
